description.value: Sora Sushi House is a Japanese sushi restaurant in New Westminster with a broad menu spanning nigiri, sashimi, specialty rolls, donburi, and appetizers, all available for pickup via an online ordering system. The restaurant has accumulated over 80 customer reviews and offers a convenient, fast turnaround for a fresh meal. A touring cyclist passing through New Westminster will find a wide variety of filling options including several vegetarian rolls and combos.
